selection: Three public figures with varied occupations and places were selected before inspecting reader and report outputs; the catalogue was then expanded using their gaps. Barbara Abramo and Rashida Jones were added later. Rafael Nadal, Rod Suskin and Evelyn Glennie were added before inspecting their outputs, but their report labels were subsequently included in a shared label inventory. Diego Maradona was added after that label work; his results were inspected before another catalogue-wide BNN expansion. Maya Angelou, Sally Ride, Toni Morrison, Kanaka Srinivasan and P. T. Usha were each selected before inspecting their outputs, but Usha's output informed later translation work. Serena Williams was selected after that work, before inspecting her output. These are convenience cases, not random or blinded. Birth-source reports were not independently authenticated. This evaluates translation and presentation parity, not predictive validity.
